d:
Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan has walked out of Dasna Jail after the Allahabad High Court granted him interim bail in an alleged money laundering case linked to Mohammad Ali Jauhar University. However, the Enforcement Directorate has challenged the bail order in the Supreme Court. With legal hurdles in the Dual PAN Card case and the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections approaching, what does this relief mean for Azam Khan's political future?
Video Editor: Rahul
